name: HG Metal Manufacturing Limited
summary: HG Metal Manufacturing Limited, an investment holding company, primarily engages in the trading of steel products. It operates through three segments: Trading, Manufacturing, and Others. The company offers various steel products, such as angle bars, API pipes, beams and columns, chequered plates, flat bars, channels, gratings, hollow sections, round/square bars, mild steel plates, steel sheet piles, galvanized sheets, shipbuilding plates, and T-bars. It also provides cut and bend, caging and rebar fabrication, and integrated coupler and computer controlled production services. In addition, the company offers tailored steel solutions for diversified industries, such as energy, heavy equipment, electronics, marine, and others; surface protection services; and precision slitting and shearing, CNC profile cut, and cut to length services, as well as logistics and shipping services. Further, it provides engineering services; and customized steel finishing services, such as galvanizing, coating, cutting, and drilling, as well as rents plates and beams to the construction industry. Additionally, the company is involved in the sourcing, retailing, and trading steel products. It has operations in Singapore, Myanmar, Malaysia, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Brunei, Thailand, Vietnam, New Zealand, Australia, Papua New Guinea, and internationally. HG Metal Manufacturing Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Singapore.
